title: How far does a hash-only sender go? A pre-registered map of sender memory versus bits for short text messages
snippet: The hash-only sender (8,190 B on a host build, keyed BLAKE2b tag included, as in every method) was the cheapest point in bits from 8,190 B up to, but excluding, PPM order 1 at 24,844 B, 45 to 46 bits below smaz2 and Unishox2; from PPM order 1 upwards, in-domain senders spend fewer bits, except order 2 pruned to 16 KiB.

title: BitDecoding-FP4: Native FP4 KV Cache Decoding via Algorithm-System Co-Design
